title: ByomEpisodeBinding (DESIGN.md §16.6 item 3; family contract L19–L22, L31, L34–L37; Δ5)
description: The §16.6 ByomEpisodeBinding field list verbatim — episode/attempt refs, the DUAL fence epochs (byom_fence_epoch AND kovee_invocation_fence, L21), context source digest, and the budget-reservation/bridge/subordinate refs (L31–L32) — plus the four family-contract field groups the §16.6 block omits (recorded gaps, slice-2 gap notes): the L22 idempotency key, the L34–L37 allowed_local_commitments set, and the Δ5 ContextManifest/ContextAssembly/ProviderContextManifest context refs. Added by the Kovee revision implementing byom_governed_work_v1 rather than overloading SageTurnBinding (§16.6 item 3); Kovee owns the host schema, this is the byom-normative shape. Lifecycle: spec/descriptors/byom-episode-binding.json (the Episode/EpisodeLease machine itself is spec/descriptors/episode.json — referenced, never re-owned).

generation.description: ActivityStream generation the Episode runs under; a stale generation is fenced (§11.2).

byom_attempt_ref.description: The exact EpisodeAttempt (Episode/EpisodeLease machine, spec/descriptors/episode.json); the attempt lifecycle is owned there, never by this record.

byom_fence_epoch.description: Byom-side fence: one of the DUAL fences every runtime mutation must present (family contract L21/R30).

kovee_invocation_fence.description: Kovee host-side fence: the other of the DUAL fences (L21/R30); a mutation carrying only one fence is invalid.

mandate_use_refs.description: MandateUse rows consumed for this Episode's authority (§13.2 tagging: every causally originating Kovee invocation carries the exact MandateUse set).

context_source_digest.description: Digest over the exact byom source-field fragment supplied to Kovee's ProviderContextManifest (provider-context-manifest-byom-fields.schema.json; §12.1, Δ5).

external_budget_bridge_ref.description: The §11.4 ExternalBudgetBridge row (byom-owned; its field list is §11.4 verbatim and lands with the byom budget ops bundle).

kovee_subordinate_reservation_digest.description: Exact subordinate Kovee reservation ref/revision/digest persisted per §11.4; the record shape is byom-subordinate-reservation.schema.json.

stable_binding_key.description: Idempotent-create key: Kovee commits the binding row at the exact episode_claim/episode_start CAS and an exact retry returns the identical row (family contract L22; UNIQUE(episode_ref, byom_attempt_ref, kovee_invocation_ref) enforced in code). NOT in the §16.6 block — recorded gap, slice-2 gap notes.

allowed_local_commitments.description: Closed set of Kovee local-commitment classes the hosted child may make intra-turn; anything else must go through call_open/pledge_propose/act_intent_* (family contract L34–L37; §16.6 item 8 names the concept but the §16.6 binding block omits the field — recorded gap).

context_manifest_ref.description: The Episode's audience-specific immutable byom ContextManifest (§12.1), rechecked at materialization (Δ5). NOT in the §16.6 block — recorded gap.

kovee_context_assembly_ref.description: Kovee ContextAssembly this Episode's context derives from (Δ5; §12.1 'preferred collaboration source'). Optional as an all-or-none pair: a purely byom-sourced Episode has none.

provider_context_manifest_ref.description: Kovee's ProviderContextManifest for this invocation (Kovee-owned, sole owner of final provider bytes — §12.1). Optional all-or-none pair: Kovee finalizes it at materialization, possibly after this row is committed.

$comment: The optional Δ5 pairs are all-or-none (oneOf arms). Cross-record equalities (the attempt belongs to the episode, the subordinate reservation belongs to the bridge, context_source_digest re-derives from the committed fragment) are enforced in code.

oneOf.$comment: Both optional Δ5 context pairs present.
Assembly pair only (provider manifest not yet finalized).
Provider pair only (byom-sourced context, no Kovee assembly).
Neither optional pair; ref/digest pairs are all-or-none.

identifier.description: Opaque visible-ASCII identifier, at most 128 bytes (§14.9).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§14.2 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant with Z offset. DESIGN.md does not fix a timestamp wire encoding; this derivation freezes with the bundle (gap note G3).

digestRef.$comment: The closed family DigestRef wire (family-vectors/PROFILE.md §6.1, normative; D-R0-1): exactly the members {class, algorithm, key_ref?, value_hex}. The oneOf pins the closed class/algorithm pairing and requires key_ref exactly for the keyed erasure classes; each arm refines members of this already-closed object.

class.description: Digest class (PROFILE.md §6, D-R0-1); substituting one class where a schema requires another is a conformance failure.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed DigestRef: every digest field is typed, never an unlabelled hash. Wire shape, class/algorithm pairing, and key_ref presence per the ratified family profile.
